KRISHNADEV S SENIOR BUSINESS ANALYST | PAYMENTS TRANSFORMATION | OPERATING MODEL & PROCESS TRANSFORMATION

Chennai, India | 9176227990 / 9600166111 | krishnadev85@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Senior Business Analyst with 14+ years of experience across Payments, Banking Operations, Reconciliation and Financial Services, with strong experience in payment transformation and operating-model change. Experienced in assessing current-state payment operations, identifying process, control and operational gaps, and supporting the design and implementation of target- state operating-model changes across People, Process and Technology for ISO 20022 and payment-modernization initiatives. Strong experience translating AS-IS findings into TO-BE processes, business requirements, process flows, business rules, implementation requirements and delivery artefacts.

Deep domain expertise in SWIFT MT/MX, ISO 20022, CBPR+, cross-border payments, payment processing, clearing, settlement, reconciliation and investigations, with experience working across Business, Operations, Technology, QA, Compliance and client stakeholders. Experienced across the change lifecycle from current-state assessment and target-state process definition through UAT, implementation support, production sign-off and operational control readiness.

CORE EXPERTISE

Operating Model & Transformation: Target Operating Model (TOM) Design & Implementation Support | People, Process & Technology | Current-State / AS-IS Assessment | Future-State / TO-BE Design | Operating Model Gap Assessment • Process Transformation: Process Transformation & Re-engineering | Process Architecture / Process Mapping | SOPs | Implementation Requirements & Roadmaps | Process Optimisation

Payments: Payments Transformation | Payment Modernization | SWIFT MT/MX | ISO 20022 | CBPR+ | Cross-Border

Payments | Payment Processing, Clearing, Settlement & Reconciliation

Payment Lifecycle: Initiation | Validation | Screening | Routing | Clearing | Settlement | Reconciliation | Investigations |

Exception Management

Business Analysis: BRD | FRD | SRS | User Stories | Acceptance Criteria | Business Rules | Functional Specifications | RTM • Delivery & Stakeholders: Stakeholder Management across Business, Operations, Technology, Compliance, QA and Client Teams | UAT / SIT | Agile / Scrum | JIRA | Confluence

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Sr. Business Analyst | Aston Carter – Client: Wells Fargo | May 2025 – Dec 2025

Supported payments transformation and ISO 20022 migration initiatives across domestic and cross-border payment flows,

working across SWIFT, CHIPS, ACH and Fed payment channels.

Conducted AS-IS vs. TO-BE gap analysis for payment processes, translating identified gaps into business requirements,

business rules, user stories, acceptance criteria and implementation requirements.

Analysed end-to-end payment journeys and process touchpoints across domestic and cross-border payment flows,

identifying gaps and operational impacts associated with ISO 20022 migration.

Supported the design and implementation of target operating-model changes across People, Process and Technology for

ISO 20022 migration, working with Business, Technology and Operations stakeholders.

Analysed payment-process and operating-model impacts associated with SWIFT MT-to-ISO 20022 MX migration, including

message transformation and data-integrity requirements.

Gathered and documented BRDs, FRDs and user stories for payment initiatives and prepared requirements/test artefacts for

ISO 20022 messages including pain.001, pacs.008, pacs.004 and camt.053.

Acted as liaison between business and technology teams for payment solutions and enhancements, supporting defect



resolution, UAT and production sign-off. Led SLA/KPI governance and operational delivery in a regulated payments environment, using JIRA and Confluence for Agile delivery and traceability.

Manager – Business Analyst | State Street Services Pvt Ltd | Feb 2023 – Jan 2025

Supported the design and implementation of the Target Operating Model (TOM) for Payments Transformation and ISO 20022 modernization, working with Business, Operations, Technology and Compliance teams to define changes across People, Process and Technology. Led AS-IS and TO-BE process analysis across the end-to-end payments lifecycle — initiation, validation, screening, routing, clearing, settlement, reconciliation and investigations — identifying gaps, manual interventions and control weaknesses.



•





Analysed end-to-end payment journeys from initiation through validation, screening, routing, clearing, settlement, reconciliation and investigations, identifying customer/operational touchpoints, pain points, manual interventions and opportunities for process improvement. Supported the definition of future-state payment journeys, aligning customer and operational touchpoints with TO-BE processes, target operating-model changes and ISO 20022 modernization requirements. Translated current-state findings into TO-BE payment processes, target operating-model requirements, business processes and implementation requirements aligned to payment-modernization objectives.

Supported definition of future-state payment processes and operating-model changes required for SWIFT MT-to-MX / ISO



20022 adoption, including downstream operational and message-processing impacts. Translated TOM and process-transformation requirements into BRDs, FRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, process flows and implementation roadmaps.

Defined and documented business processes, SOPs and operational-control changes supporting payment transformation,





and obtained stakeholder review and approval. Led global payment reconciliation, investigation and settlement-transformation activities across SWIFT MT103, MT202, MT202 COV and ISO 20022 MX messages. Identified STP, automation and process-optimization opportunities across payment validation, repair, investigations, exception handling and reconciliation.

Supported ISO 20022 migration through message mapping, data validation, downstream impact analysis and operational

change assessment.

Partnered with Development and QA through functional validation, UAT and production sign-off to ensure target-state

requirements were translated into deliverable solutions.

Lead Representative – Operations & Business Analyst | BNY Mellon Pvt Ltd | Jun 2016 – Jan 2023

Supported the implementation of target-state payment operating processes as part of payment transformation initiatives,

translating TOM and process-transformation requirements into BRDs, FRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules and implementation roadmaps.

Conducted AS-IS and TO-BE operating/process analysis across payment operations to identify manual interventions,

operational bottlenecks, control gaps and opportunities for automation and process improvement.

Mapped end-to-end payment journeys and operational touchpoints across payment processing and exception handling, identifying bottlenecks, control gaps and opportunities to improve the payment experience and straight-through processing.

Supported definition and implementation of future-state payment processes, aligning operational changes with payment-

system modernization and ISO 20022 transformation requirements.

Analysed current-state payment processes, downstream impacts, data requirements, validation rules and operational

changes associated with SWIFT MT-to-MX / ISO 20022 transformation.

Partnered with Technology, Operations and Business stakeholders to translate target-state payment requirements into

implementable business and functional requirements.

Supported payment transformation initiatives across SWIFT MT103, MT202, MT202 COV, ISO 20022 MX and CBPR+,



including message validation, payment processing and cross-border settlement. Identified STP and automation opportunities across payment validation, repair, investigations, exception handling and reconciliation.

Conducted root-cause analysis of payment failures and implemented preventive controls to improve operational resilience. • Created process flows, user stories and acceptance criteria supporting payment-transformation initiatives. Specialist – Internal Reconciliations | State Street HCL Services Pvt Ltd | Mar 2013 – Feb 2016

Performed cash and securities reconciliations, settlement activities, corporate actions and pay-down processing across

accounting and custody operations.

Defined and created process maps and SOPs, including KPIs and escalation metrics, to standardize operational processes. • Worked with Quality teams on process-standardisation and automation initiatives and completed Yellow Belt training as part of the Lean program.

Associate – Nostro Reconciliations / Payments Investigations | TCS E-Serve Pvt Ltd | Dec 2009 – Mar 2013

Worked in Nostro reconciliations and Payments Investigations, processing SWIFT and wire payments to internal and external

parties.

Handled SWIFT messages including MT103, MT202, MT599, MT500, MT509 and MT517 and supported payment processing

and investigations.

Worked with global payment modes including SEPA, Fed, CHIPS and Faster Payments, with exposure to payment controls,

reconciliations and team MIS.

EDUCATION

• MBA – Finance | Anna University | 2009

• Bachelor of Commerce – Accounting & Commerce | Madras University | 2006

APPLICATIONS / TOOLS

Payments & Reconciliation: Ezops, TLM, Geneva, Recxpress, Bloomberg, MCH (Multi Currency Horizon) • Business Analysis & Delivery: JIRA, Confluence, BRD/FRD/SRS documentation, process mapping, UAT/SIT, RTM
